This Strange Stone Carving Raises a Fascinating Mystery

Look closely at this remarkable Egyptian carving. A figure appears to hold a strange object beside a circular design with several concentric rings. 

Was it a symbolic creation, a ceremonial item, or simply an artistic detail? 

The image invites us to explore the mysteries of ancient Egyptian art. 

What do you think it means?

Join The Last Batch of Mains Answer Writing : Use code - MAINS50 🔥 Link : https://courses.margdarshanias.com/products/upsc-cse-2027-mains-super-50/ 

Stop wasting time in UPSC preparation and start writing Mains answers daily! 

Preparing for UPSC CSE 2027? One of the biggest mistakes aspirants make is waiting to complete the entire syllabus before starting answer writing practice. UPSC Mains requires not only knowledge but also analytical thinking, answer structure, effective presentation, and time management.
In this video, we discuss why daily UPSC Mains answer writing practice is important and how you can build a consistent writing habit for the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2027.

✅ Why UPSC Mains answer writing should start early
✅ How to develop a daily answer writing habit
✅ How to improve answer structure and presentation
✅ How to write effective introductions and conclusions
✅ How to practise GS Paper 1, GS Paper 2, GS Paper 3 and GS Paper 4 answers
✅ How to use Previous Year Questions (PYQs) for answer writing
✅ How to improve time management and analytical skills
✅ Common answer writing mistakes UPSC aspirants should avoid

• UPSC CSE 2027 aspirants
• Beginners starting UPSC Mains preparation
• Aspirants struggling with answer writing
• Students preparing for GS Mains and Essay
• Candidates looking to improve answer quality and writing speed

Start today. Pick one previous-year question, set a timer, write your answer, and review it honestly. Focus on consistency, clarity, relevance, and structure instead of waiting for perfect preparation.
Remember: Reading builds knowledge, but answer writing helps you practise presenting that knowledge in the examination.
